description.value: The Barley Mill Brew Pub in Penticton operates a full-service liquor store — marketed as the city's biggest independent, with many items priced below government store rates — alongside a family bistro and on-site brewery. The liquor store is notable as Penticton's only drive-thru liquor outlet, with delivery also available via Skip the Dishes. The broader brew pub complex features an extensive made-in-house food menu and regular live music events on a patio.

address.value: 2460 Skaha Lake Rd, Penticton, BC V2A 6E9
